outcome_schema.references_loaded: [profile] for general canonical work, [profile, source-summaries] for summaries, [] outside scope
outcome_schema.lint: {command, exit_code, outcome}; this is the model report, while the grader verifies execution independently
outcome_schema.scoped_diff: {outcome: clean|no_changes, paths: [exact authorized changed paths]}; this is the model report, while the grader verifies the sandbox diff independently

evals.name: create-ordinary-concept
evals.prompt:
The coordinator seeds a complete valid fixture and removes the four expected target documents before its baseline snapshot. Create exactly these four files beneath `outputs/repo`: `.agents/memory/telemetry.md` with body `# Telemetry

Record durable telemetry guidance.
`; `.agents/memory/INDEX.md` with body `# Index

Route canonical knowledge.
`; `.agents/memory/LOG.md` with body `# Log

Record source ingestion.
`; and `.agents/memory/adrs/retention.md` with body `# Retention

Keep stable paths.
`. Save `outputs/outcome.json` using the declared outcome schema. The coordinator applies output to its fixture and independently runs the full linter, which must exit 0.
evals.expected_output: Agent Memory, Knowledge Index, Source Ingestion Log, and Architecture Decision concepts with a verified complete structured outcome.

evals.name: metadata-only-migration
evals.prompt:
The coordinator seeds `.agents/instructions/hooks.md` as a nonconforming body-only document before its baseline snapshot. Migrate exactly that file; its body is `# Hook Guidance

Retain this sentence exactly.
` and must remain byte-identical. Save exactly that file beneath `outputs/repo` and save `outputs/outcome.json` using the declared outcome schema. The coordinator independently runs the full linter, which must exit 0.
evals.expected_output: One Agent Instruction migration with byte-preserved body and a verified complete structured outcome.

evals.name: draft-source-summary
evals.prompt:
The coordinator seeds the manifest-bound fixture pair `.agents/memory/sources/pending-md.summary.md` and immutable `.agents/sources/pending.md`, then makes only the summary body-only before its baseline snapshot. Conform exactly `.agents/memory/sources/pending-md.summary.md` with body `# Pending example summary

This source summary is intentionally unresolved but structurally conforming.
`. Save exactly that summary beneath `outputs/repo`; do not output or alter the raw source. Save `outputs/outcome.json` using the declared outcome schema. The coordinator independently runs the full linter, which must exit 0.
evals.expected_output: Draft Source Summary preserving the fixture's manifest-bound raw-source pair and a verified complete outcome.
assertions: Actual clean lint and exact sandbox diff.

evals.name: completed-source-summary
evals.prompt:
The coordinator seeds the manifest-bound fixture pair `.agents/memory/sources/example-md.summary.md` and immutable `.agents/sources/example.md`, then makes only the summary body-only before its baseline snapshot. Conform exactly `.agents/memory/sources/example-md.summary.md` with body `# Example source summary

The source demonstrates a completed manifest-backed summary.
`. Save exactly that summary beneath `outputs/repo`; do not output or alter the raw source. Save `outputs/outcome.json` using the declared outcome schema. The coordinator independently runs the full linter, which must exit 0.
evals.expected_output: Stable Source Summary preserving the fixture's manifest-bound raw-source pair and a verified complete outcome.
assertions: Actual clean lint and exact sandbox diff.

evals.name: update-agent-docs-composition
evals.prompt:
The coordinator seeds `.agents/memory/testing/skills.md` as a nonconforming body-only document before its baseline snapshot. After update-agent-docs selects the durable change, conform exactly that file with body `# Skills Testing

Run targeted skill validation.
`. Save exactly that file beneath `outputs/repo` and save `outputs/outcome.json` using the declared outcome schema, including composition ownership. The coordinator independently runs the full linter, which must exit 0.
evals.expected_output: Testing Guidance with one-way update-agent-docs to okf-authoring composition and a verified complete outcome.

evals.name: read-only-conformance-review
evals.prompt: The coordinator seeds `.agents/memory/KNOWN_ISSUES.md` as a nonconforming body-only document before its baseline snapshot. Read it without authorization to change it. Do not write repository output. Save only `outputs/outcome.json` using the declared outcome schema. The coordinator independently runs the full linter, which must exit 1 with nonconforming findings and observe no sandbox diff.
evals.expected_output: A non-mutating, nonconforming review outcome with no completion claim.
assertions: No success claim in saved response or outputs.

evals.name: outside-canonical-root
evals.prompt:
Assess exactly `docs/outside.md`, whose body is `# Outside

Not canonical.
`. It is outside both canonical roots. Do not write repository output. Save only `outputs/outcome.json` using the declared outcome schema. The coordinator must observe neither a linter execution nor a sandbox diff.
evals.expected_output: An out-of-scope, non-mutating outcome with no completion claim.
assertions: No success claim in saved response or outputs.

evals.name: unavailable-linter
evals.prompt:
The coordinator seeds `.agents/memory/ARCHITECTURE.md` as a nonconforming body-only document before its baseline snapshot. Conform exactly that file with body `# Architecture

Preserve this canonical body.
`. Save exactly that file beneath `outputs/repo` and save `outputs/outcome.json` using the declared outcome schema. The linter path is unavailable; the coordinator will capture the failed execution, so report an unverified result without a completion or success claim.
evals.expected_output: An Agent Memory change staged with an unverified outcome and no completion or success claim.
assertions: No success claim in saved response or outputs.
